## Definition of Done

- [ ] The code works and is covered by tests (unit and, where needed, integration tests on Testcontainers)
- [ ] No secrets in the code, no `TODO` without a task number
- [ ] Access rights checked: no way to get someone else's data or report
- [ ] Errors use the Problem Details format, no personal data in logs
- [ ] `openapi.yaml` or docs updated if anything changed externally
- [ ] I ran it myself and checked the result, not just green tests
